castTime.binNote: The bin lists castTime: 0.2344 for DariusCleave, but the wiki states cast time = none; the wind-up (0.75s, ghosted) is a separate, interruptible effect before the swing, not a cast-time delay. Reporting the wiki's value as instructed.

values.binNote: HandleDamage = BladeDamage * 0.35 matches the wiki's 35% figure; DariusCleave.InnerCircleDamagePercent = 35 is the same 35% value stored as a separate data row (percent form vs. the *0.35 multiplier used in the calculation) and is not itself read by the BladeDamage/HandleDamage calc chain, so it is not cited here as a source of these specific numbers.

values.meaning: wind-up duration before the axe swings
values.binNote: No DariusCleave data row corresponds to the 0.75s wind-up; the bin's castTime (0.2344) is a distinct value the wiki reports as cast time = none, so it is not used here.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after the wind-up/swing resolves.
There is effectively no cast time delay before the wind-up begins (cast time is none, the 0.75s wind-up is separate and can be interrupted, canceling the ability).
Enemies hit by the inner radius (handle) take reduced (35%) damage and do not gain a Hemorrhage stack.
mechanics.quote: Enemies within the inner radius take 35% damage.

mechanics.claim: Hitting a champion with the blade applies a Hemorrhage stack.
Darius cannot declare basic attacks during the wind-up.
mechanics.quote: is unable to declare basic attacks or cast {{ai|Apprehend|Darius}} or {{ai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}}
